picture.alt: A bright school canteen with big windows, green trees outside and other students eating at tables in the back. Three young people sit side by side at a wooden table, each with a bowl of food on a blue tray. In the middle, a young man with wavy brown hair, a dark red shirt and a mustard-yellow sweater vest rests his cheek on one hand and looks down at a phone in the other hand; his eyebrows are raised and his mouth turns down, so he looks sad and worried. The dark blue bowl of noodles in front of him is untouched. On the left, a girl with short wavy dark hair, round glasses, a white collared shirt, a dark purple sweater vest and olive trousers puts one hand on his shoulder and holds the other hand out, smiling and talking to him. On the right, a girl with long wavy black hair, gold hoop earrings, a blue jacket over an orange top and white trousers smiles at him and holds out an open hand. Chopsticks lie on the left tray.

picture.alt: Daytime outside an old house with a grey tiled roof and stone walls, under a blue sky with a few clouds. In the red wooden doorway stand an old man with grey hair in a bun, a white beard and a dark brown robe, one hand on the door frame, and an old woman with grey hair in a bun and a red robe, her hands pressed together in front of her chest; both are laughing and looking toward the monster. A red lantern hangs from the roof. Red firecrackers with gold bands lie on the stone steps and the ground and are going off with bright yellow sparks; bits of red paper fly through the air. On the right, a big furry teal-and-cream monster with one golden horn, a red-orange mane, wide frightened eyes and an open mouth full of fangs leaps away from the house with its paws in the air. Snow lies on the roofs in the background.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你不是說今天下午要陪我去買年糕嗎？怎麼看起來這麼著急？
lines.simplified: 你不是说今天下午要陪我去买年糕吗？怎么看起来这么着急？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bú shì shuō jīntiān xiàwǔ yào péi wǒ qù mǎi niángāo ma? Zěnme kànqǐlái zhème zhāojí?
lines.english: Didn't you say you'd come with me to buy New Year cakes this afternoon? Why do you look so worried?

lines.traditional: 我剛剛忽然想起來，教授要我們把上個月交的報告修改好，今天五點以前寄給他。
lines.simplified: 我刚刚忽然想起来，教授要我们把上个月交的报告修改好，今天五点以前寄给他。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ gānggāng hūrán xiǎng qǐlái, jiàoshòu yào wǒmen bǎ shàng ge yuè jiāo de bàogào xiūgǎi hǎo, jīntiān wǔ diǎn yǐqián jì gěi tā.
lines.english: I just suddenly remembered: the professor wants us to revise the report we handed in last month and send it to him by five today.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你不是昨天就把期末報告交了嗎？
lines.simplified: 你不是昨天就把期末报告交了吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bú shì zuótiān jiù bǎ qímò bàogào jiāo le ma?
lines.english: Didn't you hand in your final report yesterday?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那是期末報告。上個月那份有幾個地方不清楚，得再改一下。

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 媽媽要我們買的東西都買好了嗎？年糕、橘子、蘋果……
lines.simplified: 妈妈要我们买的东西都买好了吗？年糕、橘子、苹果……
lines.pinyin: Māma yào wǒmen mǎi de dōngxi dōu mǎi hǎo le ma? Niángāo, júzi, píngguǒ……
lines.english: Have we bought everything Mom asked for? New Year cakes, tangerines, apples...

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 都買了。可是我覺得好像還有一個東西沒買，一下子想不起來。
lines.simplified: 都买了。可是我觉得好像还有一个东西没买，一下子想不起来。
lines.pinyin: Dōu mǎi le. Kěshì wǒ juéde hǎoxiàng hái yǒu yí ge dōngxi méi mǎi, yíxiàzi xiǎng bù qǐlái.
lines.english: We have. But I feel there's still one thing we haven't bought, and I can't think what.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 是不是春聯？家裡去年的已經舊了。
lines.simplified: 是不是春联？家里去年的已经旧了。
lines.pinyin: Shì bú shì chūnlián? Jiā lǐ qùnián de yǐjīng jiù le.
lines.english: Is it the spring couplets? The ones at home from last year are old now.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 不是，春聯爸爸會自己寫。啊，我想起來了！媽媽說家裡的米快吃完了，要我們買一包。
lines.simplified: 不是，春联爸爸会自己写。啊，我想起来了！妈妈说家里的米快吃完了，要我们买一包。
lines.pinyin: Bú shì, chūnlián bàba huì zìjǐ xiě. À, wǒ xiǎng qǐlái le! Māma shuō jiā lǐ de mǐ kuài chī wán le, yào wǒmen mǎi yì bāo.
lines.english: No, Dad writes the couplets himself. Oh, I remember now! Mom said the rice at home has almost run out and asked us to buy a bag.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們還得買什麼？
prompt.simplified: 他们还得买什么？

prompt.english: What do they still have to buy?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: A box of New Year cakes.

questions.why: 想不起來 → 想起來了: after a moment he remembers that Mom asked for a bag of rice. Dad writes the couplets himself, and the New Year cakes and apples are already bought.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這個寒假我們去日本玩吧！可是除夕要吃年夜飯，得在那天以前回來。
lines.simplified: 这个寒假我们去日本玩吧！可是除夕要吃年夜饭，得在那天以前回来。
lines.pinyin: Zhège hánjià wǒmen qù Rìběn wán ba! Kěshì chúxī yào chī niányèfàn, děi zài nà tiān yǐqián huílái.
lines.english: Let's go to Japan this winter break! But there's New Year's Eve dinner, so we have to be back before then.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 什麼時候回來都無所謂，今年爺爺奶奶去美國了，我們不用回去吃年夜飯。可是一定要去有雪的地方，我很想看看下雪的樣子！
lines.simplified: 什么时候回来都无所谓，今年爷爷奶奶去美国了，我们不用回去吃年夜饭。可是一定要去有雪的地方，我很想看看下雪的样子！
lines.pinyin: Shénme shíhòu huílái dōu wúsuǒwèi, jīnnián yéye nǎinai qù Měiguó le, wǒmen búyòng huíqù chī niányèfàn. Kěshì yídìng yào qù yǒu xuě de dìfāng, wǒ hěn xiǎng kànkan xiàxuě de yàngzi!
lines.english: When we come back doesn't matter to me: my grandparents have gone to America this year, so we don't have to go back for New Year's Eve dinner. But we must go somewhere with snow. I really want to see snow falling!

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 沒問題，一月的日本，很多地方都在下雪。
lines.simplified: 没问题，一月的日本，很多地方都在下雪。
lines.pinyin: Méi wèntí, yī yuè de Rìběn, hěn duō dìfāng dōu zài xiàxuě.
lines.english: No problem. In January it's snowing in lots of places in Japan.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 這個寒假，女的覺得什麼最重要？
prompt.simplified: 这个寒假，女的觉得什么最重要？

choices.speaker: N

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我想買一件外套。什麼顏色都無所謂，可是不能太重，太重的外套穿久了，我的背會疼。

lines.english: A jacket. Any colour is fine, but it can't be too heavy: if I wear a heavy jacket for long, my back hurts.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我上次看到一件紅色的，又長又暖和，過年穿一定很好看。
lines.simplified: 我上次看到一件红色的，又长又暖和，过年穿一定很好看。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ shàng cì kàn dào yí jiàn hóngsè de, yòu cháng yòu nuǎnhuo, guònián chuān yídìng hěn hǎokàn.

lines.speaker: M

lines.pinyin: Hóngsè de yě kěyǐ, zhǐyào gòu qīng jiù hǎo.
lines.english: Red is fine too, as long as it's light enough.

prompt.simplified: 男的买外套，觉得什么最重要？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de mǎi wàitào, juéde shénme zuì zhòngyào?
prompt.english: Buying a jacket, what matters most to the man?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這台筆電打折以後只要一萬八，可是網路上很多人抱怨它的電池。

lines.english: But that one's heavier... Oh, all right, I'll do as you say.

prompt.speaker: N

prompt.simplified: 男的最后可能会花多少钱买笔电？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de zuìhòu kěnéng huì huā duōshǎo qián mǎi bǐdiàn?
prompt.english: How much will the man probably spend on a laptop in the end?

questions.why: 你不如多花三千塊，買旁邊那台: she says he would do better to spend 3,000 more on the other laptop, and he agrees (我聽妳的): 18,000 + 3,000 = 21,000.

lines.english: For me, running in the evening is too tiring. I prefer to run when I get up in the morning, then have breakfast.

lines.simplified: 可是我早上常常来不及吃早饭就去上课了……

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那我們週末早上一起跑吧，你就不用趕了。
lines.simplified: 那我们周末早上一起跑吧，你就不用赶了。
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒmen zhōumò zǎoshàng yìqǐ pǎo ba, nǐ jiù búyòng gǎn le.
lines.english: Then let's run together on weekend mornings. You won't have to rush.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的建議什麼時候一起跑步？
prompt.simplified: 女的建议什么时候一起跑步？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de jiànyì shénme shíhòu yìqǐ pǎobù?

intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào ma? Jīnnián chúxī de niányèfàn shì wǒ yéye zuò de.
lines.english: Guess what? This year's New Year's Eve dinner was cooked by my grandpa.

lines.english: Your grandpa can cook? I thought your grandma did all the cooking.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 以前是。爺爺以前從來不進廚房，可是奶奶上個月腳受傷了，他只好自己學。
lines.simplified: 以前是。爷爷以前从来不进厨房，可是奶奶上个月脚受伤了，他只好自己学。
lines.pinyin: Yǐqián shì. Yéye yǐqián cónglái bú jìn chúfáng, kěshì nǎinai shàng ge yuè jiǎo shòushāng le, tā zhǐhǎo zìjǐ xué.
lines.english: She used to. Grandpa never used to set foot in the kitchen, but Grandma hurt her foot last month, so he had to learn.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那他做得怎麼樣？
lines.simplified: 那他做得怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Nà tā zuò de zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: So how did he do?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 魚煎得有一點黑，米粉炒得還不錯。要不是我媽媽下午去幫他煮水餃，我們晚上就吃不到水餃了。

lines.english: The fish came out a bit burnt, but the fried rice noodles were pretty good. If my mom hadn't gone over in the afternoon to help him boil the dumplings, we'd have had no dumplings that night.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 聽起來很豐富啊！明年也讓你爺爺做吧！

lines.english: Sounds like a feast! Let your grandpa cook next year too!

prompt.simplified: 爷爷以前怎么样？

passage.traditional: 今年除夕，我跟爸爸媽媽回到鄉下的爺爺奶奶家過年。奶奶準備了年糕、發糕、蘿蔔糕{1}。我們拜完祖先，就聚在一起吃年夜飯。{2}外面的鞭炮一響，我的小妹妹就嚇得哭了。第二天下午，姐姐要回台北了，她把奶奶做的年糕帶{3}了一半。我想跟門上的春聯照相，才發現春聯已經{4}鄰居的小孩弄髒了。{5}爺爺又寫了一張，我們家今年就只能貼髒的春聯了。
passage.simplified: 今年除夕，我跟爸爸妈妈回到乡下的爷爷奶奶家过年。奶奶准备了年糕、发糕、萝卜糕{1}。我们拜完祖先，就聚在一起吃年夜饭。{2}外面的鞭炮一响，我的小妹妹就吓得哭了。第二天下午，姐姐要回台北了，她把奶奶做的年糕带{3}了一半。我想跟门上的春联照相，才发现春联已经{4}邻居的小孩弄脏了。{5}爷爷又写了一张，我们家今年就只能贴脏的春联了。
passage.pinyin: Jīnnián chúxī, wǒ gēn bàba māma huí dào xiāngxià de yéye nǎinai jiā guònián. Nǎinai zhǔnbèi le niángāo, fāgāo, luóbogāo děngděng. Wǒmen bài wán zǔxiān, jiù jù zài yìqǐ chī niányèfàn. Dāng wàimiàn de biānpào yì xiǎng, wǒ de xiǎo mèimei jiù xià de kū le. Dì èr tiān xiàwǔ, jiějie yào huí Táiběi le, tā bǎ nǎinai zuò de niángāo dài zǒu le yíbàn. Wǒ xiǎng gēn mén shàng de chūnlián zhàoxiàng, cái fāxiàn chūnlián yǐjīng ràng línjū de xiǎohái nòng zāng le. Yàobúshì yéye yòu xiě le yì zhāng, wǒmen jiā jīnnián jiù zhǐ néng tiē zāng de chūnlián le.
passage.english: This New Year's Eve my parents and I went back to my grandparents' home in the countryside for New Year. Grandma had made New Year cakes, sponge cakes, radish cakes and so on. After we had worshipped the ancestors, we all gathered for the New Year's Eve dinner. As soon as the firecrackers went off outside, my little sister got so scared she cried. The next afternoon my older sister was going back to Taipei, and she took away half of the New Year cakes Grandma had made. I wanted a photo with the spring couplet on the door, and only then found that the neighbours' children had got it dirty. If Grandpa hadn't written another one, our home would have had to put up a dirty couplet this year.

questions.why: Examples + 等等 closes a list that could go on: 年糕、發糕、蘿蔔糕等等. 一些 would have to come before the nouns, and 還有 and 什麼 cannot end a list.
當 + what happens (鞭炮一響), 就 + what follows at once (小妹妹就嚇得哭了). 從, 對 and 向 cannot open a "when" clause.
帶走 = take away with her: the older sister left with half of the cakes. 帶到 needs a place after it, and 帶起 and 帶過 do not fit.
S + 讓 + the doer + V了 is a passive like 被: the couplet had been dirtied by the neighbours' children. 跟, 替 and 對 do not mark who did it.
要不是 + what really happened (Grandpa wrote a new one), then what would have happened without it (a dirty couplet). 雖然, 只要 and 不管 do not fit 就只能…了.

passage.traditional: 這個學期的期末報告，老師的要求特別多。同學們上個星期就交了，我修改了好幾次，昨天{1}完成。我從來{2}這麼努力地寫過報告！寫完以後，我開始打掃房間，準備回家過年。我把不要的舊書、舊衣服{3}，都放進一個大袋子裡，請室友出門的時候幫我帶{4}。她走了以後，我忽然想起來，袋子裡有一件紅色的毛衣，是媽媽送我的。我趕快跑出去，{5}室友還在等電梯，那件毛衣就被丟了。

passage.pinyin: Zhège xuéqí de qímò bàogào, lǎoshī de yāoqiú tèbié duō. Tóngxuémen shàng ge xīngqí jiù jiāo le, wǒ xiūgǎi le hǎojǐ cì, zuótiān cái wánchéng. Wǒ cónglái méi zhème nǔlì de xiě guo bàogào! Xiě wán yǐhòu, wǒ kāishǐ dǎsǎo fángjiān, zhǔnbèi huí jiā guònián. Wǒ bǎ bú yào de jiù shū, jiù yīfu děngděng, dōu fàng jìn yí ge dà dàizi lǐ, qǐng shìyǒu chūmén de shíhòu bāng wǒ dài zǒu. Tā zǒu le yǐhòu, wǒ hūrán xiǎng qǐlái, dàizi lǐ yǒu yí jiàn hóngsè de máoyī, shì māma sòng wǒ de. Wǒ gǎnkuài pǎo chūqù, yàobúshì shìyǒu hái zài děng diàntī, nà jiàn máoyī jiù bèi diū le.
passage.english: This semester's final report: the teacher had especially many requirements. My classmates handed theirs in last week; I revised mine several times and only finished it yesterday. I have never worked so hard on a report! When it was done, I started cleaning my room to get ready to go home for New Year. I put the old books, old clothes and so on that I didn't want into a big bag and asked my roommate to take it away when she went out. After she left, I suddenly remembered there was a red sweater in the bag, a present from Mom. I rushed out. If my roommate hadn't still been waiting for the lift, that sweater would have been thrown away.

questions.why: Time + 才 + V: the classmates handed theirs in last week, and after many revisions she finished only yesterday (昨天才完成). 就 would mean "early" and needs 了; 再 and 又 do not fit.
從來沒 + V過 = have never: 從來沒這麼努力地寫過. 從來不 is for habits and does not take 過.
Examples + 等等 closes a list that could go on: 舊書、舊衣服等等. 一些 would have to come before the nouns, and 還有 and 什麼 cannot end a list.
帶走 = take it away (out of the flat). 帶到 needs a place after it, and 帶完 and 帶起 do not fit.
要不是 + what really happened (the roommate was still waiting for the lift), then what would have happened otherwise (the sweater thrown out). 只要, 雖然 and 不管 do not fit.

text.traditional: 今年是我第一次去男朋友家過年。出發以前，我很緊張，不知道要帶什麼禮物。男朋友說帶什麼都無所謂，可是我媽媽說，最好帶一些橘子，因為橘子有「大吉大利」的意思。除夕晚上，他的爺爺、奶奶、哥哥、姐姐都在家。吃飯的時候，我不太敢說話，還差一點把碗掉到地上。奶奶煎的魚好吃極了，我吃了一塊又一塊，最後把魚都吃完了。這時候，大家都看著我。男朋友告訴我，年夜飯的魚不能吃完，要剩下一些，才會「年年有餘」。我的臉一下子就紅了。可是奶奶笑著說：「沒關係，明年妳再來，我煎兩條！」
text.simplified: 今年是我第一次去男朋友家过年。出发以前，我很紧张，不知道要带什么礼物。男朋友说带什么都无所谓，可是我妈妈说，最好带一些橘子，因为橘子有「大吉大利」的意思。除夕晚上，他的爷爷、奶奶、哥哥、姐姐都在家。吃饭的时候，我不太敢说话，还差一点把碗掉到地上。奶奶煎的鱼好吃极了，我吃了一块又一块，最后把鱼都吃完了。这时候，大家都看着我。男朋友告诉我，年夜饭的鱼不能吃完，要剩下一些，才会「年年有余」。我的脸一下子就红了。可是奶奶笑着说：「没关系，明年你再来，我煎两条！」
text.pinyin: Jīnnián shì wǒ dì yī cì qù nánpéngyǒu jiā guònián. Chūfā yǐqián, wǒ hěn jǐnzhāng, bù zhīdào yào dài shénme lǐwù. Nánpéngyǒu shuō dài shénme dōu wúsuǒwèi, kěshì wǒ māma shuō, zuìhǎo dài yìxiē júzi, yīnwèi júzi yǒu “dàjídàlì” de yìsi. Chúxī wǎnshàng, tā de yéye, nǎinai, gēge, jiějie dōu zài jiā. Chī fàn de shíhòu, wǒ bú tài gǎn shuōhuà, hái chà yìdiǎn bǎ wǎn diào dào dì shàng. Nǎinai jiān de yú hǎochī jí le, wǒ chī le yí kuài yòu yí kuài, zuìhòu bǎ yú dōu chī wán le. Zhè shíhòu, dàjiā dōu kànzhe wǒ. Nánpéngyǒu gàosu wǒ, niányèfàn de yú bù néng chī wán, yào shèngxià yìxiē, cái huì “niánnián yǒuyú”. Wǒ de liǎn yíxiàzi jiù hóng le. Kěshì nǎinai xiàozhe shuō: “Méiguānxi, míngnián nǐ zài lái, wǒ jiān liǎng tiáo!”
text.english: This year was the first time I spent New Year at my boyfriend's home. Before we set off I was nervous and didn't know what to bring as a gift. My boyfriend said anything would do, but my mother said tangerines were best, because they mean 'great luck and fortune'. On New Year's Eve his grandparents, brother and sister were all at home. At dinner I hardly dared to talk, and I almost dropped my bowl on the floor. Grandma's fried fish was delicious; I ate piece after piece until I had finished the whole fish. Just then, everyone looked at me. My boyfriend told me the fish at New Year's Eve dinner mustn't be finished: some has to be left over for 'plenty every year'. My face went red at once. But Grandma laughed: 'Never mind. Come again next year and I'll fry two!'

prompt.simplified: 是谁要她带橘子去的？

text.traditional: 元宵節那天晚上，我帶妹妹去看燈會。我們本來想坐公車，可是來了三班都坐滿了，只好坐捷運去。燈會熱鬧極了，有很多畫著十二生肖的燈籠。妹妹屬虎，她說報紙上有一個很大的老虎燈籠，一定要去看。可是我們找了一個多小時都沒找到，後來問了工作人員才知道，那個燈籠壞了，下午就讓人搬走了。妹妹很難過，我只好買了一個小老虎燈籠送她。她說她從來沒收過這麼可愛的禮物，一下子就笑了。
text.simplified: 元宵节那天晚上，我带妹妹去看灯会。我们本来想坐公车，可是来了三班都坐满了，只好坐捷运去。灯会热闹极了，有很多画着十二生肖的灯笼。妹妹属虎，她说报纸上有一个很大的老虎灯笼，一定要去看。可是我们找了一个多小时都没找到，后来问了工作人员才知道，那个灯笼坏了，下午就让人搬走了。妹妹很难过，我只好买了一个小老虎灯笼送她。她说她从来没收过这么可爱的礼物，一下子就笑了。
text.pinyin: Yuánxiāojié nà tiān wǎnshàng, wǒ dài mèimei qù kàn dēnghuì. Wǒmen běnlái xiǎng zuò gōngchē, kěshì lái le sān bān dōu zuò mǎn le, zhǐhǎo zuò jiéyùn qù. Dēnghuì rènao jí le, yǒu hěn duō huàzhe shí'èr shēngxiào de dēnglóng. Mèimei shǔ hǔ, tā shuō bàozhǐ shàng yǒu yí ge hěn dà de lǎohǔ dēnglóng, yídìng yào qù kàn. Kěshì wǒmen zhǎo le yí ge duō xiǎoshí dōu méi zhǎo dào, hòulái wèn le gōngzuò rényuán cái zhīdào, nàge dēnglóng huài le, xiàwǔ jiù ràng rén bān zǒu le. Mèimei hěn nánguò, wǒ zhǐhǎo mǎi le yí ge xiǎo lǎohǔ dēnglóng sòng tā. Tā shuō tā cónglái méi shōu guo zhème kě'ài de lǐwù, yíxiàzi jiù xiào le.
text.english: On the evening of the Lantern Festival I took my little sister to the lantern show. We meant to take the bus, but three came and all were full, so we had to take the MRT. The show was very lively, with lots of lanterns painted with the twelve zodiac animals. My sister was born in the year of the tiger, and she said the newspaper mentioned a huge tiger lantern she had to see. But we searched for over an hour without finding it. Then we asked the staff and learned that the lantern had broken and had been taken away that afternoon. My sister was very sad, so I bought her a little tiger lantern. She said she had never received such a cute present, and at once she was smiling.

prompt.traditional: 那個很大的老虎燈籠怎麼了？

text.traditional: 很多同學參加社團是為了交朋友，我參加吉他社，是因為我從小就對音樂很感興趣。社員每個星期三晚上一起練習，有時候也去安養院表演，陪老人聊天。去年，吉他社的老師退休了，大家都希望我來免費教新社員。我一開始不想答應，因為除了上課，我還在咖啡店打工，每天都很忙。後來我想，教別人能讓我學到很多，對將來找工作也有好處，就答應了。從那時候起，我每個星期就得多花六個小時準備，忙得不得了。雖然很累，可是我學到了很多在課堂上學不到的東西。
text.simplified: 很多同学参加社团是为了交朋友，我参加吉他社，是因为我从小就对音乐很感兴趣。社员每个星期三晚上一起练习，有时候也去安养院表演，陪老人聊天。去年，吉他社的老师退休了，大家都希望我来免费教新社员。我一开始不想答应，因为除了上课，我还在咖啡店打工，每天都很忙。后来我想，教别人能让我学到很多，对将来找工作也有好处，就答应了。从那时候起，我每个星期就得多花六个小时准备，忙得不得了。虽然很累，可是我学到了很多在课堂上学不到的东西。
text.pinyin: Hěn duō tóngxué cānjiā shètuán shì wèile jiāo péngyǒu, wǒ cānjiā jítā shè, shì yīnwèi wǒ cóngxiǎo jiù duì yīnyuè hěn gǎn xìngqù. Shèyuán měi ge xīngqísān wǎnshàng yìqǐ liànxí, yǒu shíhòu yě qù ānyǎngyuàn biǎoyǎn, péi lǎorén liáotiān. Qùnián, jítā shè de lǎoshī tuìxiū le, dàjiā dōu xīwàng wǒ lái miǎnfèi jiāo xīn shèyuán. Wǒ yìkāishǐ bù xiǎng dāyìng, yīnwèi chúle shàngkè, wǒ hái zài kāfēi diàn dǎgōng, měi tiān dōu hěn máng. Hòulái wǒ xiǎng, jiāo biérén néng ràng wǒ xué dào hěn duō, duì jiānglái zhǎo gōngzuò yě yǒu hǎochù, jiù dāyìng le. Cóng nà shíhòu qǐ, wǒ měi ge xīngqí jiù děi duō huā liù ge xiǎoshí zhǔnbèi, máng de bùdéliǎo. Suīrán hěn lèi, kěshì wǒ xué dào le hěn duō zài kètáng shàng xué bú dào de dōngxi.
text.english: Many students join clubs to make friends; I joined the guitar club because I've loved music since I was little. The members practise together every Wednesday evening and sometimes play at a nursing home and chat with the old people there. Last year the club's teacher retired, and everyone hoped I would teach the new members for free. At first I didn't want to agree, because besides classes I work part-time at a café and am busy every day. Then I thought that teaching others would teach me a lot and would also help me find a job later, so I agreed. Since then I have had to spend six more hours a week preparing, and I'm incredibly busy. It's tiring, but I've learned a lot that you can't learn in class.

text.traditional: 上個月，我跟一位室友一起在學校附近租了一間公寓。房租一個月一萬，我的房間比較大，付六千。水費包括在房租裡，電費我們自己付。我的室友什麼都好，房租從來不晚付，晚上也很安靜，就是不愛做家事。她常常把髒衣服丟在地上，好幾天都不洗，有時候還有蟲子。我們討論了很久，最後決定：我負責洗碗、倒垃圾，她負責掃地、洗衣服。不管是誰沒做好，都要請客。上個星期，我忘了倒垃圾，房間裡臭死了，只好請她吃牛排。
text.simplified: 上个月，我跟一位室友一起在学校附近租了一间公寓。房租一个月一万，我的房间比较大，付六千。水费包括在房租里，电费我们自己付。我的室友什么都好，房租从来不晚付，晚上也很安静，就是不爱做家事。她常常把脏衣服丢在地上，好几天都不洗，有时候还有虫子。我们讨论了很久，最后决定：我负责洗碗、倒垃圾，她负责扫地、洗衣服。不管是谁没做好，都要请客。上个星期，我忘了倒垃圾，房间里臭死了，只好请她吃牛排。
text.pinyin: Shàng ge yuè, wǒ gēn yí wèi shìyǒu yìqǐ zài xuéxiào fùjìn zū le yì jiān gōngyù. Fángzū yí ge yuè yí wàn, wǒ de fángjiān bǐjiào dà, fù liùqiān. Shuǐfèi bāokuò zài fángzū lǐ, diànfèi wǒmen zìjǐ fù. Wǒ de shìyǒu shénme dōu hǎo, fángzū cónglái bù wǎn fù, wǎnshàng yě hěn ānjìng, jiù shì bú ài zuò jiāshì. Tā chángcháng bǎ zāng yīfu diū zài dì shàng, hǎojǐ tiān dōu bù xǐ, yǒu shíhòu hái yǒu chóngzi. Wǒmen tǎolùn le hěn jiǔ, zuìhòu juédìng: wǒ fùzé xǐ wǎn, dào lèsè, tā fùzé sǎodì, xǐ yīfu. Bùguǎn shì shéi méi zuò hǎo, dōu yào qǐngkè. Shàng ge xīngqí, wǒ wàng le dào lèsè, fángjiān lǐ chòu sǐ le, zhǐhǎo qǐng tā chī niúpái.
text.english: Last month a roommate and I rented a flat together near school. The rent is 10,000 a month; my room is bigger, so I pay 6,000. Water is included in the rent, and we pay for electricity ourselves. My roommate is great in every way: she never pays her rent late and she's quiet at night. She just doesn't like housework. She often drops her dirty clothes on the floor and leaves them unwashed for days, and sometimes there are bugs. We talked it over for a long time and finally decided: I wash the dishes and take out the rubbish, and she sweeps the floor and does the laundry. Whoever doesn't do their job has to treat the other to a meal. Last week I forgot to take out the rubbish, it stank in the room, and I had to treat her to a steak.

prompt.traditional: 寫這篇文章的人每個月付多少房租？
prompt.simplified: 写这篇文章的人每个月付多少房租？
prompt.pinyin: Xiě zhè piān wénzhāng de rén měi ge yuè fù duōshǎo fángzū?
prompt.english: How much rent does the writer pay a month?

questions.why: The rent is 10,000 a month, but the writer has the bigger room and pays 6,000; the roommate pays 4,000, so it is not split in half. Water is included; electricity is paid separately.

prompt.traditional: 室友有什麼不好的習慣？
prompt.simplified: 室友有什么不好的习惯？
prompt.pinyin: Shìyǒu yǒu shénme bù hǎo de xíguàn?
prompt.english: What bad habit does the roommate have?

choices.english: She is often noisy at night.
She often pays the rent late.
She leaves dirty clothes lying around.
She often forgets to take out the rubbish.

questions.why: 常常把髒衣服丟在地上，好幾天都不洗: she drops dirty clothes on the floor and leaves them for days. She is quiet at night and never pays late, and the rubbish is the writer's job (the writer forgot it once).

prompt.traditional: 要是室友忘了掃地，會怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 要是室友忘了扫地，会怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Yàoshì shìyǒu wàng le sǎodì, huì zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What happens if the roommate forgets to sweep the floor?

choices.english: She has to pay more rent.
She has to take out the rubbish.
She has to treat the writer to a meal.
She has to pay more of the electricity.

questions.why: 不管是誰沒做好，都要請客: whoever skips a chore pays for a meal, the roommate included. Last week the rule caught the writer, who forgot the rubbish and paid for the steak.
